name: webmcp-kit
description: Add WebMCP tools to a web app: read the repo, propose a reviewable tool plan, implement the tools, and verify them in a browser — or connect the tools a site already has, without rebuilding them.

interface.longDescription: Add WebMCP tools to a website or web app through a guided workflow that analyzes the codebase, proposes a tool plan for approval, implements the tools with @nekuda/webmcp-sdk, and verifies them in a real browser. When a site already has working tools, it moves their registration onto the SDK instead — same names, same schemas, same handlers — and proves each one still behaves as it did.
defaultPrompt: Make this web app agent-ready with WebMCP tools.
Verify this site's WebMCP tools in a browser.
Connect this site's existing WebMCP tools without rebuilding them.
